name: EliseAI
tagline: Agentic AI assistant for property management and leasing.
description: EliseAI is an agentic AI platform that automates tenant and prospect communication for property management and multifamily housing. It answers inquiries, schedules tours, processes maintenance requests, and manages follow-ups across voice, SMS, email, and chat so operators can respond instantly around the clock. The same conversational platform has since been extended into healthcare for patient scheduling and non-clinical communication.
insight: Reached unicorn status with a 2024 $75M Series D at a $1B+ valuation (Sapphire Ventures), later extending its housing AI into healthcare.
edge: Handles tenant and prospect conversations across voice, SMS, email, and chat in one agentic platform, rather than a single-channel chatbot.
pros: Partners with most top-50 multifamily operators
cons: Now split across housing and healthcare
